SessionStart.command: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const path=await import('node:path');const os=await import('node:os');const url=await import('node:url');const geminiHome=process.env.GEMINI_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.gemini');const bases=[process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT,path.join(geminiHome,'config','plugins','agy-pulse'),path.join(process.cwd(),'.agents','plugins','agy-pulse'),process.cwd()].filter(Boolean);for(const b of bases){const f=path.join(b,'sidecars','pulse','dist','hook-session.mjs');if(fs.existsSync(f)){await import(url.pathToFileURL(f).href);return;}}process.stdout.write('{}\n');}).catch(()=>{process.stdout.write('{}\n');});"

PreInvocation.command: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const path=await import('node:path');const os=await import('node:os');const url=await import('node:url');const geminiHome=process.env.GEMINI_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.gemini');const bases=[process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT,path.join(geminiHome,'config','plugins','agy-pulse'),path.join(process.cwd(),'.agents','plugins','agy-pulse'),process.cwd()].filter(Boolean);for(const b of bases){const f=path.join(b,'sidecars','pulse','dist','hook-session.mjs');if(fs.existsSync(f)){await import(url.pathToFileURL(f).href);return;}}process.stdout.write('{}\n');}).catch(()=>{process.stdout.write('{}\n');});"

hooks.command: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const path=await import('node:path');const os=await import('node:os');const url=await import('node:url');const geminiHome=process.env.GEMINI_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.gemini');const bases=[process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT,path.join(geminiHome,'config','plugins','agy-pulse'),path.join(process.cwd(),'.agents','plugins','agy-pulse'),process.cwd()].filter(Boolean);for(const b of bases){const f=path.join(b,'sidecars','pulse','dist','hook-session.mjs');if(fs.existsSync(f)){process.env.AGY_PULSE_HOOK_MODE='pretool-guard';await import(url.pathToFileURL(f).href);return;}}process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'})+'\n');}).catch(()=>{process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'})+'\n');});"
